Full port of skill.rs (293 lines) -> packages/coding-agent/src/tools/skill.ts, plus a new prerequisite packages/coding-agent/src/skills-state.ts (port of crates/coding-agent/src/skills_state.rs, manifest unit coding-agent/skills_state, phase 11 pending -- pre-completed because set-skill-state.ts/remove-skill.ts hard-depend on it; not a tool file, not on the phase-9 do-not-touch list). Two-phase preview/confirm, source-pin mismatch rejection, and the 'no loaded skill named X ... Did you mean: A, B?' hint (shared helper findLoadedSkillOrThrow in ./skill.ts, identical text in oracle's set_skill_state.rs and remove_skill.rs) all ported verbatim. Full port of remove_skill.rs (610 lines) -> packages/coding-agent/src/tools/remove-skill.ts. Same architecture as ./skill.ts and ./set-skill-state.ts (see those ledger rows). Deletion scope: only source==='user' skills removable (scope guard remove_skill.rs:136-146, verbatim message incl. 'builtin skills are compiled in; project skills belong to the repo'); optional source pin must also resolve to 'user' (remove_skill.rs:148-158). NOT applied (TODO(port), documented inline): audit_entry_id always undefined, same architectural gap as set-skill-state.ts/install-skill.ts. Oracle's builtin_cannot_be_removed test has no fixture-able analog (no builtin-scope skill source exists in this repo's loader, see ./skill.ts's resolveSkillSource doc) -- ported project_cannot_be_removed instead, which exercises the identical scope-guard error-formatting code path via the 'project' branch. Tests: new test/remove-skill-tool.test.ts (8 tests ported from remove_skill.rs's #[cfg(test)] block: schema shape, deletionTarget unit tests (in-root dir/file/escape-refused), preview-does-not-delete, confirm-deletes-and-reload-drops-it, project-skill-cannot-be-removed, remove-clears-overlay-entry, unknown-skill-typed-error, permission-classification-always-prompts); writes_remove_audit intentionally not ported (no audit sink to assert against).

Full port of web_fetch.rs (365 lines) -> packages/coding-agent/src/tools/web-fetch.ts. Content-type html-sniff kept case-sensitive (.includes("html"), bug-for-bug: "text/HTML" would not match). Schema/description text byte-identical to web_fetch.rs:267 (Tool.description) and :271 (url param description). User-Agent hardcoded pie/0.75.0 (oracle Cargo.toml pin at the pie @0a120dfd snapshot) with a TODO(port) note, same convention as packages/ai/src/utils/headers.ts's userAgent(). Tests: test/web-fetch-tool.test.ts, 16 cases -- 7 are the oracle #[cfg(test)] block ported verbatim (html_to_text/collapse_whitespace incl. non-ascii/emoji, replacement-char, nbsp-in-script, indented-paragraph blank-line cap), plus schema-shape, redirect-follow-to-cap and past-cap error, streaming-truncation-at-exact-cap-byte-count (6 MiB body against a local http server), and cancellation (pre-aborted + mid-wait) integration cases matching the oracle e2e suite's (web_fetch_e2e.rs, phase-13 char-tests unit, not this unit) scenario shapes.
